names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 18 mai, «Sfântul Mucenic Dionisie»; the epithet is not the calendar's but is taken from the life it links, which has him imprisoned at Lampsacus.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 18 Μαΐου, «Άγιοι Πέτρος, Διονύσιος, Ανδρέας, Παύλος, Χριστίνα, Ηράκλειος, Παυλίνος και Βενέδιμος οι Μάρτυρες», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the heading of the Охридски пролог’s second entry for 18. мај ст. ст., „Свети мученици Петар, Дионисије, Андреј, Павле и Христина.“ — Свети is not a rank and мученици the `martyr` this corpus puts in `types`, so the heading leaves five bare forenames and the body adds nothing to any of them but a description. Measured with `foldchk.py` before drafting: `[('dionysius-companion-of-quadratus', 'sr'), ('dionysius-companion-of-socrates', 'sr')]`. The folds are read in this batch’s commit message.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 18 mai — «Sfântul Mucenic Dionisie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 18ης Μαΐου — «Άγιοι Πέτρος, Διονύσιος, Ανδρέας, Παύλος, Χριστίνα, Ηράκλειος, Παυλίνος και Βενέδιμος οι Μάρτυρες»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same civil day the Romanian calendar already keeps him on, and its closing verse agrees: «Ὀγδοάς, Ἀθλοφόρων ἐκ γαίης εἰς πόλιν ἤρθη». **One page carries eight head names and the corpus keeps four of them**, so this company is four upgrades and four new folders in batch `el-05-18` — Andrew and Paul of Mesopotamia, Heraclius and Benedimus of Athens. **The Greek dates the whole company by one reign and no year**: «Όλοι αυτοί οι Άγιοι μαρτύρησαν στα χρόνια του αυτοκράτορα Δεκίου (249-251 μ.Χ.)», so no `dates` object is added or altered here. **Two hymns of the company are copied**, an apolytikion in Ἦχος δ’ that names all eight and a kontakion in the same tone; both are the company's own service and neither is a mis-hang. **The page does not repeat the corpus's Lampsacus for him**: it gives Lampsacus to Peter alone, and says of Dionysius only that he was stoned at Athens together with Paul, Andrew and Christina. The existing slug and display name are not touched — he is plainly the same man of the same company on the same day — and the silence is recorded here. **Its couplet names him among the three stoned**: «Tρεις συντρίβουσι πίστεως στερρούς λίθους, Παύλον Διονύσιον Aνδρέαν λίθοις».

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 31.05.2026 (18. мај ст. ст.) — „Свети мученици Петар, Дионисије, Андреј, Павле и Христина.“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry, on the same menologion 18/5 the Romanian and Greek rows already carry. **A FIRST DATE FOR A FOLDER THAT HELD NO `dates` OBJECT**: „То је било 250. године“ → `death` 250. **The year is given of the whole episode and not of one man** — the sentence closes an entry about all five and about Nicomachus — which is why it is written here and why Solochon’s 298 was withheld from Pamphamer and Pamphylon on the Julian 17 May: there the year was given of one man in a sentence about him. 250 falls inside the reign of Decius, 249 to 251, which saint.gr gives for the whole company, so there is no disagreement. **New here**: that the Prologue calls him a man of standing, and above all **the end of Nicomachus**, which no other book read for this company carries: „одрече се Христа усред мука, и наедном сиђе с ума, па као бесан гризаше своје тело и бацаше пену на уста докле не издахну“ — he denied Christ in the middle of the tortures, went out of his mind at once, and gnawed his own flesh and foamed at the mouth until he expired. `peter-of-lampsacus`’s life already records the denial off doxologia; **the madness and the death are this book’s**. **Nicomachus gains no folder and no row**: he is an apostate and no calendar read for this corpus keeps him, `ls saints | grep -iE 'nicomach'` returns nothing, and by the coordinator’s third ruling nothing is minted for him. `types` untouched. No `locations`; this entry names no place at all, where the Romanian has Lampsacus and the Greek has Athens. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nesctricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfinților Mucenici Petru, Dionisie, Paulin și al Sfântului Mucenic Teodot și al celor șapte», Glasul 4 — the one troparion the page prints for all the martyrs of the day

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their contests received the crowns of incorruption from Thee our God; for having Thy strength, they cast down the tyrants and broke the feeble insolence of the demons. At their prayers, O Christ our God, save our souls.

hymns.text: Τῶν ἀθλοφόρων τὸν ὀκτάριθμον δῆμον, μαρτυρικοὶς ἐγκωμιάσωμεν ὕμνοις, Παυλῖνον Διονύσιον καὶ Πέτρον ὁμοῦ, Ἀνδρέαν καὶ Βενέδιμον, τὸν θεόφρονα Παῦλον, Ἡράκλειον τὸν ἔνδοξον, καὶ Χριστίναν τὴν θείαν οὗτοι καὶ γὰρ πρεσβεύουσιν ἀεί, ὑπὲρ τοῦ κόσμου. Χριστῷ τῷ θεῷ ἠμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος δ’, Ὃ ὑψωθεῖς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ, on the page of the eight martyrs of 18 Μαΐου

english.text: Let us praise with martyrs' hymns the eight-numbered company of the victors: Paulinus, Dionysius and Peter together, Andrew and Benedimus, God-minded Paul, glorious Heraclius and divine Christina; for these intercede always for the world with Christ our God.

hymns.text: Διαφόρων πόλεων ἐξωρμημένοι, οὐρανίου πόλεως, πολῖται ὢφθητε σεπτοί, χορόν λαμπρόν συγκροτήσαντες Μάρτυρες θεῖοι, Τριάδος ὑπέρμαχοι.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον, on the page of the eight martyrs of 18 Μαΐου

english.text: Setting out from different cities, you were shown to be honoured citizens of the heavenly city, forming one bright choir, divine martyrs, champions of the Trinity.

death.note: The Охридски пролог for 18. мај ст. ст., closing its second entry: „То је било 250. године.“ The year is given of the episode, which is the whole company and Nicomachus with them, and not of one man. This folder held no `dates` object at all until now; saint.gr gave only the reign of Decius, 249 to 251, inside which 250 falls.
